best_match.fbbt_definition: Any aminergic neuron of the adult.

justification: The authors' call is a group of octopaminergic and tyraminergic neurons. FBbt has no Tdc2 or octopaminergic-tyraminergic grouping term (searches returned only individual octopaminergic/tyraminergic types). Octopaminergic neuron is not a subclass of tyraminergic neuron: OLS ancestors (page size 500) of adult octopaminergic neuron (FBbt:00058203) and adult tyraminergic neuron (FBbt:00058204) share aminergic neuron / adult aminergic neuron (FBbt:00058201) as the most specific common parent; neither lists the other. Adult aminergic neuron is not obsolete.
